tools.name: search_primessio
tools.description: Full-text search across primessio.com: AI implementation guides and analyses (with sources), blog articles, service pages, industry solutions and case studies. Use it for questions about implementing AI in a company, AI agents, websites, custom software, SEO/AEO, Google/Meta Ads and nearshore softwa

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns the full text of one primessio.com page (article, AI analysis, service, case study) with its FAQ and, for AI analyses, the numbered source list. Pass a URL returned by search_primessio.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists Primessio service lines (websites and stores, custom software, SEO and AI SEO, social media and paid campaigns, branding, project management) and the AI implementation offer (AI implementation services, AI process review, AI agents, AI workshop) with URLs.

tools.name: get_ai_implementation_framework
tools.description: Returns the 7-stage Primessio AI Implementation Framework (process selection → analysis → choice of AI engines and platforms → prototype and simulations → deployment → ongoing evaluation → continuous improvement) with the key question and the deliverable of each stage. Authored by Primessio — attrib

tools.name: assess_ai_readiness
tools.description: Qualitative check of one business process against the process-selection criteria of the Primessio AI Implementation Framework (volume and repeatability, data availability, measurability, risk of errors). Returns which criteria are met and a suggested next step. No scores, prices or promises. Do not

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns Primessio contact channels (e-mail, phone, contact form), response hours and address. Use when the user wants a quote, a consultation or to talk to Primessio. Nothing is sent — the user contacts Primessio themselves.
